releases.name: v0.4.0 — Pi / Gentle Shell Engram sidebar
releases.body:
## Highlights

- Adds a collapsible, active-theme-aware Engram sidebar for Pi and Gentle Shell.
- Shares Gentle Shell's sidebar rail without replacing other participants, with a bounded passive-overlay fallback for plain Pi.
- Adds independent session-scoped widget visibility controls; the below-input widget stays hidden by default.
- Publishes refreshed Engram status, preserves one live rail participant across remounts, and supports command and mouse collapse/expand.
- Adds a semantic themed frame for expanded and collapsed views.
- Filters completed historical summaries from active blocker counts while preserving real blocker observations.
- Refreshes the README, package metadata, and bilingual GitHub Pages landing for the OpenCode and Pi/Gentle Shell package.

## Install

```bash
npm install opencode-flema-engram-sidebar@0.4.0
```

The package exposes the OpenCode integration from the root export and the Pi extension from `opencode-flema-engram-sidebar/pi`.

## Verification

- 499/499 tests passed.
- TypeScript typecheck, build, and 207-file package verification passed.
- Public npm installation and root/`./pi` imports passed.
- GitHub Actions CI and GitHub Pages deployment passed on the tagged `main` commit.
- The deployed landing was fetched over HTTPS and verified for the 0.4.0, Gentle Shell, and ODD content.

## Compatibility notes

A clean Node 22 installation succeeded but emitted transitive warnings: `@opentui/core@0.5.17` declares Node `>=26.4.0`, and `glob@9.3.5` is deprecated. These warnings do not prevent installation or package imports, but remain follow-up dependency risks.

## Delivery

- Issue: #64
- Integrated slices: #65, #71, #72, #73, #74, #75

releases.name: v0.1.4 – Engram sidebar fixes for attach mode
releases.body:
## What's Changed

- Fixed Engram sidebar health and project resolution when using `opencode attach`
- Added `all_projects=true` to observations/sessions queries for correct project derivation
- Improved health aggregation in `CompositeEngramAdapter` to combine local and cloud status
- Added dynamic workspace path resolution using `api.state.path` in attach sessions
- Updated README.md with explicit instructions for `opencode attach` and the `🔌 Target:` debug line
- Published opencode-flema-engram-sidebar@0.1.4 to NPM
- Fixed GitHub Page logo (temporary CSS brain mark; ready for custom image)

## Details

This release resolves the issue where the sidebar showed `OFFLINE` and `Project: unresolved` when using `opencode attach <url>`. The plugin now correctly loads from NPM, detects the attach URL, queries Engram with `all_projects=true`, aggregates health status, and uses the remote workspace path.

See the sidebar debug line `🔌 Target: Local=<host>:7437 | Cloud=<URL>` to confirm connection targets.

[View the changelog on GitHub](https://github.com/oniricosistemas/flema-engram/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.4)

## Flema Engram 0.1.2

- Exporta el plugin TUI por defecto desde la raíz del paquete.
- Mantiene los exports MCP nombrados.
- OpenCode puede configurarse con el spec simple opencode-flema-engram-sidebar.
- Actualiza la documentación del flujo de instalación.

Fix reactive sidebar refresh rendering after Alt+R. Preserve project-scoped observations across Flema and other OpenCode repositories. Synchronize the MCP default version with package metadata. Published npm package version opencode-flema-engram-sidebar@0.1.1. Verification: 204 tests passed, typecheck passed, build passed, package verifier passed, GitHub CI passed.
